description: Find agent stacks by problem domain or text. A query is split into words and any of them may match, against the name, the copy, and the prompt. When nothing matches, the reply is labelled and filled with the most established stacks.

query.description: What the agent needs to do, in your own words. Split into words; any may match.

topic.description: A problem domain id, e.g. software-devops.

name: search_stacks
